headline: Anthropic signs $10B compute deal; Oregon weighs data-center pause
body: A quiet day. Anthropic signed a roughly $10 billion compute deal with Volta and confirmed a custom chip team, raising Capability Velocity and Power Concentration and lifting Enslaved God, Zookeeper and Descendants. Oregon Democrats proposed a three-year pause on large data centers, a small Tech Backlash signal. Horizon Balance slipped to -0.13.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Enslaved God +0.09, from the Anthropic-Volta deal (+0.13), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04); Zookeeper +0.06, from the Anthropic-Volta deal (+0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04).
